hook.text: Piazzolla wanted the record to sound as if half-drunk players had played it in a bordello.

sentences.text: The music was first developed for a theater piece about the history of tango.
Pablo Zinger had served as musical director for that stage production.
Piazzolla played the bandoneon and recorded with his Quinteto Tango Nuevo.
Pablo Ziegler and Pablo Zinger played piano, and Horacio Malvicino played guitar.
The saxophone on Rough Dancer came from Paquito D'Rivera.
Nonesuch Records put out a reissue of the album in the late 1990s.
